# Puppy Whippies

Puppy Whippies is a Las Vegas area pilot-batch dog treat cup brand. The site lets local dog families review current whipped treat cup flavors and request availability by email. No payment is collected on the website.

## Key Pages

- Home: https://puppywhippies.com/
- Flavor lineup: https://puppywhippies.com/flavors/
- Las Vegas dog treats: https://puppywhippies.com/las-vegas-dog-treats/
- Ingredients and serving notes: https://puppywhippies.com/ingredients/
- About Puppy Whippies: https://puppywhippies.com/about/
- Request availability: https://puppywhippies.com/request/

## Current Flavor Concepts

- Strawberry Dream Whip
- Blueberry Bliss Puff
- Carrot Patch Fluff
- Berry Medley Mix
- Cucumber Cool Swirl
- Sampler Pack

## Important Facts

- Service area: Las Vegas area, with pickup or delivery fit confirmed per request.
- Contact: hello@puppywhippies.com
- Buying process: visitors request availability by email; ingredients, serving notes, timing, and local fit are confirmed before any pickup, delivery, or payment.
- Safety note: Puppy Whippies treats are not veterinary products. Pet owners should supervise dogs while serving treats and review ingredients for household-specific concerns.
